content.text: I have 4 of 5 EQE measurements done. The best so far is index 9 (Sb 0.52). Before spending the last one, I'm checking the crystal phases by XRD.
Index 1 (Ag-rich end) shows FTO plus metallic Ag, so that side is unlikely to be good. Index 10 is AgSbO3 pyrochlore, the photoactive phase, so my last EQE measurement goes there.

input.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.095%) at Sb=0.52, close to AgSbO3 stoichiometry. XRD at nearby index 10 (Sb=0.56) matches AgSbO3 pyrochlore (mp-540872, 0.77), which is the photoactive phase. EQE falls off on both sides of the 1:1 composition.

rejected.reason: Pyrochlore, but EQE 0.080% is below index 9

content.text:
I submitted **index 9** (Sb fraction 0.52). At 0.095% it had the highest EQE of the five compositions I measured. I used the full EQE budget of 5 and 2 of the 5 XRD scans. The other 25 compositions were never measured, so a better one could still be on the line.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.33 | 0.074 |
| 6 | 0.41 | 0.043 |
| **9** | **0.52** | **0.095** |
| 10 | 0.56 | 0.080 |
| 17 | 0.77 | 0.029 |

- **Why the 1:1 region:** index 9 is close to the 1:1 Ag:Sb ratio of AgSbO₃. The XRD scan of index 10 (Sb 0.56) best matched AgSbO₃ pyrochlore (similarity 0.77), which is the likely light-absorbing phase. EQE fell away on both sides of this region.
- **Ag-rich end:** the scan of index 1 (Sb 0.25) looks like the FTO substrate plus metallic silver. That's my reading of the peaks: the database matches were all weak, and the tool didn't test the silver-metal pattern directly. There was no sign of the Ag₃SbO₄ phase. It suggests that end is poor, but I didn't spend an EQE measurement to confirm it.
- **Not tested:** the curve isn't smooth: EQE dropped at 0.41 and then rose again at 0.52. The optimiser's top suggestions were the unmeasured indices 11 and 12 (Sb 0.60 and 0.64). I chose index 10 for the last measurement because it was the confirmed pyrochlore. The true peak could be anywhere between about 0.45 and 0.60.
